title: AI coding is here to stay
author: Classic-Ad8554
selftext:
So over a three day weekend after building my first steam game. I decided to give a new language a try, one for AI. 

Using my own custom harness, I built out my new assembly language and machine code.  From that I built a compiler and a high-level language using the AI.  The AI using the new language was able to construct a triple self-replicating compiler self-hosted from the c# compiler we started with. 

With that in hand I had it build out an entire tool chain and IDE with a full step debugger and visual representations of the architecture and code it built.  

Then I had it build its own host as well as run on .NET. 

In three days  I went from an Idea to a full new language and self-hosted toolchain.  

I built a freemium app with it to replace a spreadsheet ai was using for churning.  I plan to build some more apps but so far I’ve got several demos that hit all the Enterprise app basics. It’s definitely not a toy at this point. 

The AI couldn’t do this just 12 months ago, this is just the start. 

https://unlistedchurn.com
